journeys.title: Amalfi Coast
journeys.overview: Amalfi Coast is a 7-night journey in Amalfi Coast, Italy. Lemon groves above Amalfi. The days are few on purpose. One strong experience is better than a full page of stops.

days.title: Arrival along the coast
days.body: Leave Naples by car and follow the road as it narrows above the sea. By late afternoon you are in Positano, with time to walk down to the beach before dinner.

days.title: A day on the water
days.body: A small boat runs toward Capri. Swim at the base of the cliffs, then return for a long lunch of lemon, mozzarella, and grilled fish.

days.title: Ravello
days.body: The morning is for the gardens at Ravello and the view from the terrace. The afternoon is unscheduled.

days.title: Path of the Gods
days.body: Walk a section of the Sentiero degli Dei with a guide, ending in a hamlet for coffee. Transfer back before the road gets busy.

days.title: Atrani and Amalfi
days.body: Spend the day between Atrani’s small harbor and the duomo in Amalfi. Dinner is on a terrace, not in a dining room.

days.title: At your own pace
days.body: A pool morning, a shop for ceramics if you want one, and an early evening passeggiata.

days.title: Departure
days.body: Breakfast with the coast still in shadow, then the drive back to Naples.
